User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User (matches Firebase Auth UID).

username.description: The display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

GameLobby.title: GameLobby
GameLobby.description: Represents a game lobby where players gather before a game starts.

accessCode.description: A short, unique code for players to join the lobby.

creatorId.description: The UID of the user who created the lobby.

playerIds.description: An array of UIDs of the players currently in the lobby.

status.description: The current status of the lobby.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the lobby was created.

Game.title: Game
Game.description: Represents the full state of a single game of Pocha.

lobbyId.description: Reference to the GameLobby this game belongs to.

playerIds.description: Array of UIDs for players participating in this game.

players.description: Denormalized data for each player in the game for UI rendering.

status.description: The current phase of the game.

currentPlayerId.description: UID of the player whose turn it is.

currentTrick.description: The cards played in the current trick.

trumpSuit.description: The trump suit for the current round.

roundSequence.description: Sequence of card counts for all rounds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the game was created.

Card.title: Card
Card.description: A single playing card from the Spanish deck.
